text: In seventeen twenty three the Dzungars attack in spring when your auls are spread wide, and they are free on their other border, so many families flee in the Great Disaster.
In seventeen twenty six the three Zhuzes meet at Ordabasy and unite under Abulkhair Khan with Batyrs Bogenbai, Kabanbai and Raiymbek.
One united army can now plan together, so you win at Bulanty and then at Anyrakay, and the invasion is turned back.
